{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}

module DistCache.Client
  ( CachePool
  , PoolConfig(..)
  , ConnState(..)
  , initPool
  , withConnection
  , cacheGet
  , cachePut
  ) where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, try, evaluate)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- | Connection state tracking
data ConnState = ConnState
  { connHost     :: !String
  , connPort     :: !Int
  , connSocket   :: !(IORef (Maybe SocketHandle))
  , connAlive    :: !(IORef Bool)
  , connGeneration :: !Int
  }

-- | Opaque socket handle (simulated)
data SocketHandle = SocketHandle
  { shFd       :: !Int
  , shBuffer   :: !(IORef (Maybe String))
  }

data PoolConfig = PoolConfig
  { pcHost        :: String
  , pcPort        :: Int
  , pcMaxConns    :: Int
  , pcIdleTimeout :: Int
  , pcRetryCount  :: Int
  }

data CachePool = CachePool
  { poolConfig     :: !PoolConfig
  , poolConns      :: !(MVar [ConnState])
  , poolGeneration :: !(IORef Int)
  , poolMetrics    :: !(MVar PoolMetrics)
  }

data PoolMetrics = PoolMetrics
  { pmTotalConns   :: !Int
  , pmActiveConns  :: !Int
  , pmFailedConns  :: !Int
  }

-- | Initialize a connection pool
initPool :: PoolConfig -> IO CachePool
initPool cfg = do
  conns <- newMVar []
  gen <- newIORef 0
  metrics <- newMVar (PoolMetrics 0 0 0)
  return $ CachePool cfg conns gen metrics

-- | Create a new connection
mkConnection :: PoolConfig -> Int -> IO ConnState
mkConnection cfg gen = do
  sockRef <- newIORef Nothing
  aliveRef <- newIORef True
  buf <- newIORef (Just "")
  let sh = SocketHandle 42 buf
  writeIORef sockRef (Just sh)
  return $ ConnState (pcHost cfg) (pcPort cfg) sockRef aliveRef gen

-- | Validate that a connection is still usable
validateConn :: ConnState -> IO Bool
validateConn cs = do
  alive <- readIORef (connAlive cs)
  if not alive
    then return False
    else do
      mSock <- readIORef (connSocket cs)
      case mSock of
        Nothing -> return False
        Just sh -> do
          mBuf <- readIORef (shBuffer sh)
          return $ mBuf /= Nothing

-- | Acquire a connection from the pool, with generation tracking
acquireConn :: CachePool -> IO ConnState
acquireConn pool = do
  currentGen <- readIORef (poolGeneration pool)
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  case findValid currentGen conns of
    (Just conn, rest) -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) rest
      valid <- validateConn conn
      if valid
        then return conn
        else do
          invalidateConn conn
          acquireConn pool
    (Nothing, rest) -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) rest
      mkConnection (poolConfig pool) currentGen

-- | Find a valid connection matching current generation
findValid :: Int -> [ConnState] -> (Maybe ConnState, [ConnState])
findValid _ [] = (Nothing, [])
findValid gen (c:cs)
  | connGeneration c == gen = (Just c, cs)
  | otherwise = let (found, rest) = findValid gen cs
                in (found, c : rest)

-- | Return a connection to the pool
releaseConn :: CachePool -> ConnState -> IO ()
releaseConn pool conn = do
  currentGen <- readIORef (poolGeneration pool)
  if connGeneration conn == currentGen
    then do
      conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
      putMVar (poolConns pool) (conn : conns)
    else invalidateConn conn

-- | Invalidate a connection (close socket, mark dead)
invalidateConn :: ConnState -> IO ()
invalidateConn cs = do
  writeIORef (connAlive cs) False
  mSock <- readIORef (connSocket cs)
  case mSock of
    Just sh -> writeIORef (shBuffer sh) Nothing
    Nothing -> return ()
  writeIORef (connSocket cs) Nothing

-- | Execute an action with a pooled connection
withConnection :: CachePool -> (ConnState -> IO a) -> IO a
withConnection pool action = do
  conn <- acquireConn pool
  result <- try (action conn)
  case result of
    Right val -> do
      releaseConn pool conn
      return val
    Left (e :: SomeException) -> do
      invalidateConn conn
      -- Retry with fresh connection on failure
      conn' <- acquireConn pool
      result' <- try (action conn')
      case result' of
        Right val -> do
          releaseConn pool conn'
          return val
        Left (e' :: SomeException) -> do
          invalidateConn conn'
          error $ "cache operation failed after retry: " ++ show e'

-- | Internal: read from connection's socket buffer
-- Safe version: validates connection state before accessing buffer
readFromConn :: ConnState -> IO String
readFromConn cs = do
  mSock <- readIORef (connSocket cs)
  case mSock of
    Nothing -> error "connection closed"
    Just sock -> do
      bufContent <- readIORef (shBuffer sock)
      return $ fromMaybe "" bufContent

-- | Write to connection's socket buffer  
writeToConn :: ConnState -> String -> IO ()
writeToConn cs msg = do
  mSock <- readIORef (connSocket cs)
  case mSock of
    Nothing -> error "cannot write to closed connection"
    Just sh -> writeIORef (shBuffer sh) (Just msg)

-- | Get a value from the distributed cache
cacheGet :: CachePool -> String -> IO (Maybe String)
cacheGet pool key = withConnection pool $ \conn -> do
  writeToConn conn ("GET " ++ key)
  resp <- readFromConn conn
  if null resp
    then return Nothing
    else return (Just resp)

-- | Put a value into the distributed cache
cachePut :: CachePool -> String -> String -> IO ()
cachePut pool key val = withConnection pool $ \conn -> do
  writeToConn conn ("PUT " ++ key ++ " " ++ val)
  _ <- readFromConn conn
  return ()
